# `matter/fabric/RealmMatterBridges.js`

> **Source:** `engine/matter/fabric/RealmMatterBridges.js`

Identity-preserving contracts at the packet-codec and Realm Forge boundaries.

## Classes

### `class RealmPacketRuntimeBridge`

Live, sparse Fabric state attached to codec lineages without inflating the mandatory packet record. The codec remains physical-state authority; this bridge verifies that every current representation still names the same region, root lineage, definition, and source revision.
